user.title: OpenCARWINGS
user.description: Sign in with your OpenCARWINGS account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read fresh data from the server. This never wakes the car. Only a command button does that.
data_description.api_base_url: Base URL of your OpenCARWINGS server. The public instance is https://opencarwings.viaaq.eu
data_description.command_pin: Your OpenCARWINGS account's command PIN, set on the server, not in Home Assistant. The server refuses door lock and unlock, horn, lights and remote start without it. Leave blank if your account has no PIN set.
data_description.gps_max_radius_km: Distance from Home, in km. Fixes further out than this are ignored and the last good one stays on the map. Useful when the head unit is set to the wrong map region or its map data is out of date, so it reports the car a long way from where it is. Set 0 to accept every fix.
data_description.username: The account you sign in with on the OpenCARWINGS server.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
